ai_summary.text:
カナミックネットワークは介護・医療向けクラウドサービスを提供するSaaS企業。介護保険事業所向けの業務支援クラウド「カナミック」を主力に、地域包括ケアの情報連携プラットフォームを全国の自治体・医療機関・介護施設に提供している。

売上55億円（前年比+9.9%）と堅調な増収。営業利益16億円（営業利益率29.2%）、純利益11億円。SaaSモデルの高い収益性が29%超の営業利益率を実現。ROE23.9%と極めて高い資本効率。

自己資本比率71.1%、財務健全性スコア100点と最高評価の財務。営業CF13億円、FCF5億円。EPS23円に対しPER20.2倍、配当8円。2025年問題（団塊世代の後期高齢者化）で介護需要は急拡大しており、介護DXの構造的な需要がプラットフォームの成長を支えている。なお、EPS23.4円、PER20.2倍、1株当たり配当金7.5円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: Canamic Network is a SaaS company providing cloud services for nursing care and medical fields. Its main product is the "Canamic" business support cloud for long-term care insurance providers, and it provides a regional comprehensive care information platform to local governments, medical institutions, and nursing care facilities nationwide.  Revenue increased steadily to  5.5 billion (+9.9% YoY). Operating income was  1.6 billion (29.2% operating margin), and net income was  1.1 billion. The high profitability of the SaaS model resulted in an operating margin of over 29%. ROE is extremely high at 23.9%.  The equity ratio is 71.1%, and the financial soundness score is a top-rated 100 points. Operating CF is  1.3 billion, and FCF is  500 million. With EPS of  23 and a PER of 20.2x, the dividend is  8. With the 2025 problem (the aging of the baby boomer generation), demand for nursing care is rapidly expanding, and the structural demand for nursing care DX is supporting the platform's growth. Furthermore, with EPS at  23.4, PER at 20.2x, and dividend per share at  7.5, management is promoting initiatives that balance shareholder returns and corporate value enhancement.
